key.name: locations
key.summary: Configured cities to show weather for
key.description: The locations shown in the world view of Brolly. Each value is a GVariant returned by gweather_location_serialize().

key.name: window-width
key.description: The width of the main window.

key.name: window-height
key.description: The height of the main window.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether or not the window is maximized.

key.name: provider
key.description: Where weather data comes from. "libgweather" uses the backends built into libgweather (see libgweather-providers); the others are fetched directly. API keys for providers that need one are kept in the keyring.

key.name: libgweather-providers
key.description: Backends libgweather may use when provider is "libgweather". Any of "metar", "met-no", "owm" and "nws".

key.name: migrated-from-gnome-weather
key.description: Whether saved places and preferences were imported from GNOME Weather (org.gnome.Weather) on first run.
